withdrawal_severity.normalization_note: Removed target-token amount is normalized to the pool side holding the target token (no token0 + token1 double counting). USD prefers event amount_usd, then stablecoin quote, then target amount x pool price_usd at or before the event block.

volume.note: Legacy Dune events without token addresses are inferred by decimal magnitude; same-decimals quote pools are skipped.

wallet_activity.note: USD per swap prefers Dune amount_usd, then stablecoin quote, then target amount x pool price_usd at or before the swap block. By default, Trade, Mover, Volume, and Activity use within-window percentile cutoffs; explicit arguments retain fixed thresholds.
